findings.issue: ReferenceError: path not in scope in section 5 try block. const path = require('node:path') on line 103 is block-scoped to section 4.
findings.recommendation: Add const path = require('node:path') inside section 5 try block or hoist to function level.

findings.issue: ReDoS: checkEnforcementGap() constructs regex from patternId without escaping metacharacters. patternId.replace(/-/g, '[\s-]') does not escape regex specials.
findings.recommendation: Apply escapeRegex() from flow-utils.js to patternId before regex construction.

findings.issue: ReDoS: recordViolationPattern() builds regex from patternKey without escaping. patternKey derived from user-controlled cluster.description.
findings.recommendation: Apply escapeRegex() to patternKey before regex construction on line 351 and line 491.

findings.issue: Markdown/prompt injection: cluster.description and instances interpolated into decisions.md without sanitization. Could inject misleading rules.
findings.recommendation: Sanitize inputs with heading-stripping and newline removal before interpolation into markdown.

findings.issue: DRY violation: mapCategoryForPromotion() is identical to mapAuditCategoryToLearnerCategory() in flow-standards-learner.js. Also buildPromotionRuleTemplate() overlaps with buildAuditRuleTemplate().
findings.recommendation: Delete duplicates from flow-audit.js and import from flow-standards-learner.js.

findings.issue: Promotion failure silently classified as TRACKING. When promoteToDecisions() fails (e.g., section not found), status shows TRACKING instead of an error state.
findings.recommendation: Add PROMOTION_FAILED status and include promoteResult.reason in patternResult.

findings.issue: Raw JSON.stringify + fs.writeFileSync used instead of flow-utils writeFile pattern. Inconsistent with project security standards.
findings.recommendation: Use writeFile from flow-utils or add const fs = require('node:fs') at proper scope.

findings.issue: Magic number thresholds (5, 3) for severity classification not extracted as named constants.
findings.recommendation: Extract as SYSTEMIC_THRESHOLD and MEDIUM_THRESHOLD constants.

findings.issue: Fuzzy matching in checkEnforcementGap may produce false positives — patternId counts toward match threshold, and common words like 'code' pass the length filter.
findings.recommendation: Separate patternId check from description word matching. Consider stopword filter.
